title: Board Drag Keeps Selected Style
description: When dragging a selected board piece at detail LOD, the node suddenly shows hover/highlight style instead of keeping selected primary color. Fix style resolution so selected elements keep selected chrome during drag.
summary: Fixed board style resolution so committed selection keeps primary selected chrome when hovered during node drag (detail LOD). Root cause: `hovered_style_kind` applied hover paint over selection when `set_hovered_id` ran on drag start. Fix: skip hover chrome for ids in `selection`. Added Rust regression tests; rebuilt WASM.
